'''Ross Touriel''' is a Star Wars CCG player named in [[Tim Guzman]]'s Mega Tournament II report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. Guzman wrote that Touriel was around 11 years old and played [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]].<ref name="mega">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Mega Tournament II in Huntington Beach California], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234227/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
